text:
mia: Hey folks, first-day issue  My MacBook Pro (M2, macOS 13.6) finished setup but the company VPN client fails with 'certificate pin mismatch' and MDM shows 'comms error' for remote commands. Any quick troubleshooting?

it-support: Hi @mia  welcome! Quick checks: are you on corp Wi-Fi or personal hotspot? Also paste the exact VPN error and any MDM status message you see in System Settings -> Profiles.

mia: On redwood-secure. VPN error: 'TLS: certificate pin mismatch (expected SHA256:abcd...)'. In Profiles it shows 'Redwood MDM: Enrolled' but last check-in says 'Comms failure: 502'.

it-support: Sounds like a cert rotation + proxy issue. We rolled a VPN server cert rotation this morning that includes a new pin. Corp proxy occasionally rewrites TLS or inserts its own cert; that can break pinning. Can you try switching to your phone hotspot to see if VPN connects?

mia: Tried hotspot, VPN connects on hotspot but MDM still shows 502.

emily: @mia we push MDM commands via a LB pool; sometimes a partial cert chain on one node causes 502 until caches clear. @it-support can you check LB certs and whether the device is hitting an unhealthy node?

it-support: Checking... one LB node had an intermediate missing (same as earlier today), restarted the agent and pushed cert chain fix. Devices should re-check in within a few minutes. @mia can you open Terminal and run: `profiles show -type enrollment` and paste the top lines?

mia: Output: 'Enrollment Profile: id=xyz, status=Pending, lastCheckin=2026-03-05T09:10:12Z'.

it-support: Pending means the MDM hasn't received the device's handshake after restart. Try forcing a check-in: `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` (we can grant temporary sudo if needed).

mia: I don't have admin. @emily could I get temp sudo for 1 hour?

emily: Granted 1h sudo.

mia: Ran it. Output: 'Renewal failed: TLS handshake failed: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate'.

it-support: That's the LB cert chain earlier; if hotspot allowed VPN but corp Wi-Fi triggers proxy, the device might still contact the broken LB node internally. Can you reboot and try another check-in? Also try `curl -v https://mdm.redwood.internal/enroll` to see TLS response (paste redacted output).

mia: After reboot the `profiles renew` worked and status changed to 'Enrolled' and lastCheckin is now current. VPN works on corp Wi-Fi too.

it-support: Great! We'll monitor the LB health check to prevent recurrence. One more: FileVault didn't ask during setup for me, is that auto-enabled?

mia: It wasn't enabled, I turned it on and it asked for my password.

macbot: [automated] FileVault personal recovery key escrowed to KMS for device C02ABCD1234.

it-support: Confirmed escrow. Welcome to Redwood, @mia! We'll follow up with a short note in the onboarding doc about 'if cert pin or 502 during enroll, try hotspot and force profiles renew after LB fix.'

emily: Welcome! Ping #new-hires for anything else. :)
